products.name: Turquoise Cotton Floral Printed Straight Suit Set
products.description: An elegant turquoise straight-cut suit set adorned with traditional hand-blocked floral patterns, fine thread work at the yoke, and a sheer lightweight dupatta.

products.name: Rust Printed Straight Suit Set
products.description: Sophisticated rust orange direct-line silhouette suit with abstract artisanal print detailing, matching relaxed trouser pants, and a gorgeous patterned border drapery.

products.name: Red Embroidered Art Silk Straight Suit Set
products.description: Indulge in festive luxury with this vibrant red art-silk kurta set. Features rich, golden brocade hand embroideries on the collar neckline and sleeves.

products.name: Green Cotton Floral & Chevron Printed Straight Suit Set
products.description: A delightful amalgamation of floral prints and geometric chevrons in a rich pine-green shade. Soft breathable cotton fabric perfect for hot Indian summers.

products.name: Purple Rayon Printed Straight Kurta Set
products.description: Chic daily wear purple rayon comfort kurta with micro floral prints, contrasting block-print dupatta, and cozy matching cigarette trousers.

products.name: Mayura Banarasi Silk Saree
products.description: Handloomed with golden Zari work, this traditional Banarasi Silk Saree features peacock motifs and an ornate floral pallu in deep royal indigo and crimson.

reviews.author: Anjali G.
reviews.comment: The zari work is incredibly detailed and heavy. The drape is elegant and has a majestic sheen.
reviews.brandReply: Thank you Anjali! Each saree is woven by our master artisans to bring out that royal sheen.

products.name: Classic Linen 2-Piece Co-ord Set
products.description: A breezy, minimalist 2-piece Co-ord Set featuring a relaxed-fit linen tunic and matching wide-leg trousers in an organic terracotta hue.

products.name: Kavya Embroidered 3-Piece Co-ord Set
products.description: A versatile, elegant 3-piece linen-silk ensemble consisting of a hand-embroidered crop bustier, tailored high-rise trousers, and a fluid, sheer overlay jacket.

reviews.author: Meera R.
reviews.comment: Beautiful hand embroidery and very comfortable for hot climates. The overlay jacket can be paired with so many other outfits!
reviews.brandReply: Meera, we love that you are styling the sheer overlay jacket in multiple ways! Versatility is core to our brand.

products.name: Meera Pastel Organza Saree
products.description: A dreamy, lightweight pastel sage green Organza Saree finished with hand-painted floral vignettes and delicate scalloped embroidery on the borders.
